R-45 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A tethered inspection platform with a higher brochure payload than the R-30, for projects needing additional sensing or tooling.

Vehicle weight: 42 kg
Depth rating: 350 m
Payload: 8 kg
Dimensions: 675 × 500 × 445 mm
Camera: 1080p; 4× optical zoom
Camera tilt: ±90°
Power: External tethered supply

Configuration note: A payload allowance is not an assurance that any sensor will integrate. Confirm the specific sensor model, interfaces and tested setup.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
